value.rationale: This reconstructibility question asks precisely when a natural numerical model-theoretic invariant loses the size partition of a finite metric parameter set. The complete two-threshold result identifies unique sharp counterexamples at ten points, two first same-k counterexamples at sixteen, and permanent ambiguity thereafter, together with a natural refined invariant that exactly recovers the omitted structure. It provides motivated nontrivial finite boundaries rather than arbitrary isolated numerical entries.
